brief: Create three distinct ads for Cedar Ridge Chiropractic's saved $49 new-patient exam and consultation. Speak to adults in the Austin area considering a first visit. Use a warm, professional, plain-spoken tone and invite them to learn about the consultation and book an appointment. Use only supplied brand facts; do not promise results or invent services, availability, included scans, or offer terms.

concept.headline: See a chiropractor for $49
concept.primary_text: Ready to see what a spinal assessment looks like? Cedar Ridge offers a new-patient exam and consultation for $49. Get a clear starting point in Austin, Round Rock, or Cedar Park. Same-day appointments are available for new patients.
concept.description: New-patient exam and consultation for $49. Same-day availability in Austin, Round Rock, and Cedar Park.
concept.rationale: This ad targets price-sensitive adults in Austin who are curious but hesitant about the cost of a first visit. By leading with the specific $49 price point, it removes financial ambiguity immediately, aligning with the 'Save money / value' angle. The copy emphasizes transparency and accessibility (same-day) rather than clinical outcomes, which keeps the claim factual and low-risk. The visual supports this by showing a clean, approachable environment rather than a clinical or salesy setting.

visual.direction: A bright, modern chiropractic clinic waiting area in Austin. Natural light streams through large windows, illuminating clean, neutral tones (whites, greys, light wood). The focal point is a comfortable, modern armchair positioned slightly off-center. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a calm, professional space with subtle plants. No people are present. The top 40% of the image is uncluttered, featuring a plain wall or soft background element to allow for high-contrast text overlay. The mood is inviting and professional, avoiding clinical sterility.

concept.headline: Back pain slowing you down?
concept.primary_text: Stop letting chronic discomfort dictate your days. Cedar Ridge Chiropractic in Austin offers a clear starting point with a $49 new-patient exam and consultation. Meet with a board-certified chiropractor to understand your spine and explore practical care plans designed for your lifestyle. No guessing, just a direct path to relief. Book your same-day appointment today.
concept.description: Learn how a $49 exam helps identify your spine’s specific needs in Austin, Round Rock, or Cedar Park.
concept.rationale: This ad targets the core pain point of adults with desk jobs or athletic injuries who feel stuck in discomfort. By leading with the problem and immediately offering a low-barrier, transparent solution ($49 exam), it reduces the perceived risk of trying a new clinic. The visual supports this by showing a calm, professional environment where assessment happens, reinforcing the 'understand your spine' message without making unsubstantiated health promises.

visual.direction: A close-up, warm-toned photograph of a chiropractor’s hands gently resting on the shoulder and upper back of a seated patient during a consultation. The focus is on the hands and the relaxed posture of the patient, conveying care and assessment. The background is softly blurred, showing the clean, modern interior of a clinic with natural light. The palette is neutral and calming: soft beiges, whites, and muted wood tones. Exclude any visible instruments, logos, or text. Ensure the top third of the image is uncluttered space suitable for headline placement.

sourceQuotes: Board-certified chiropractors with 15+ years combined experience

concept.headline: Stiff from sitting?
concept.primary_text: Desk hours can leave your back tight. Cedar Ridge offers a $49 new-patient exam and consultation to address your specific concerns. Our board-certified chiropractors provide same-day appointments for new patients. See what a first visit involves and book your time.
concept.description: $49 exam and consultation with board-certified chiropractors in Austin.
concept.rationale: This ad targets adults 30-60 with desk jobs who experience stiffness from prolonged sitting. By leading with the specific pain point of 'sitting,' it resonates immediately with the target audience's daily reality. The visual uses a calm, professional close-up to convey trust without alarming the viewer, while the copy explicitly links the $49 offer to the solution of a personalized consultation. The mention of same-day appointments addresses the urgency often felt when pain is acute, making the next step (booking) feel accessible and low-commitment.

visual.direction: A high-quality, close-up photograph of a person's upper back and shoulders, viewed from behind, seated in a modern, minimalist office chair. The subject is wearing a simple, neutral-colored t-shirt. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting a calm, professional environment. The focus is sharp on the posture of the shoulders and neck, subtly implying tension or stiffness, while the background is blurred into soft, warm tones of beige and light wood to create a welcoming, non-clinical atmosphere. No faces are visible. The composition leaves the upper third of the image clear and uncluttered for text placement.

visual.direction: A bright, modern chiropractic consultation room in Austin. concept.headline: First visit: $49 exam and consult
